title: OnlyCoords
description: Lightweight customizable coordinates HUD for Fabric. The clean F3 alternative.
body:
![Overview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e59ee5df92089fafe8204fe960558a398ef5d6b_0.webp)# OnlyCoords

The Minecraft Fabric mod that shows just your coordinates. Nothing else.

## Why OnlyCoords?

The F3 debug screen is cluttered with information you don't need most of the time. OnlyCoords does one thing well : a clean, compact, fully configurable coordinates HUD that stays out of your way.

## Features

- 9 anchor positions with pixel-precise offset control
- Customizable scale, decimal precision, color, shadow, and background
- Optional cardinal direction indicator (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW)
- In-game configuration via ModMenu + YACL — no JSON editing required
- Customizable toggle keybinding to show/hide on demand
- Auto-hides when F3 is open (optional)
- Locale-aware decimal formatting with consistent point separator
